title: Punt AST: Player Targets
markdown:
**Summary.** Our data names only three punt AST fits: Khaman Maluach, Aaron Nesmith and Tari Eason. All three sit near or past our 144-player cutoff, so they are end-of-auction or waiver pieces, not a build you can draft around. Assists are scarce late and hard to find on waivers, so decide early whether you punt them, and get threes, steals and FT% from other players because these three do little to cover them.

## The list is very thin

Only three players in our data carry the punt AST tag: Khaman Maluach, Aaron Nesmith and Tari Eason. None of them is an early or mid-round piece. Maluach should cost 1 to 3 USD at the end of the auction. Eason is a 1 USD last-pick flyer at most. Nesmith is better left on waivers and watched. ([Khaman Maluach](#player/344), [Aaron Nesmith](#player/412), [Tari Eason](#player/156))

This means a punt AST build in our league cannot be filled from a target list. You build it with your early and mid-auction money on players who give little in assists. These three are just late roster filler that fits the plan. ([Khaman Maluach](#player/344), [Aaron Nesmith](#player/412), [Tari Eason](#player/156))

## Why you must decide early

Assists are very hard to find on waivers. Big assist players are rare late in drafts. If you spend early money on low-assist players, you can fall behind in assists with no way back. In our 12-team auction with 144 players drafted, plan to either win assists with early buys or give the category up on purpose. ([07-07](https://youtu.be/ME-r173X5b0?t=1073), [07-07](https://youtu.be/ME-r173X5b0?t=1284))

The experts lean two ways. One view says points and assists are very hard to find in good volume late, so secure them early. The other view agrees they are scarce late but says that if you miss them early, you can simply punt them. Both sides agree on the scarcity. They differ on whether that pushes you to pay up for assists or to walk away from the category. ([09-07](https://youtu.be/E-KmhvyZ2CU?t=799), [09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=1822), [07-07](https://youtu.be/ME-r173X5b0?t=1284))

A practical rule: by the time your first few players are bought, check your assist total. If it is low and the remaining big assist players are going for full price, commit to the punt. Do not split the difference and stay weak in assists while also paying for them. ([09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=1822), [07-07](https://youtu.be/ME-r173X5b0?t=1284))

## What the punt costs and what it gives

Punting assists brings turnovers down automatically. That helps you in the TO category every week. The risk is in threes, steals and FT%, where low-assist players often struggle. Check those three categories at every stage of the auction. ([09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=630))

Our three targets do not fix that risk. Maluach gives blocks, rebounds and FG%. His note also pairs him with punt STL builds, so do not count on him for steals. Our data gives nothing on his threes or FT%. ([Khaman Maluach](#player/344), [09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=630))

Eason does give steals, along with rebounds. His three-point shot and FG% still need to recover, so his threes are a question mark. Our data gives nothing on his FT%. ([Tari Eason](#player/156))

Nesmith's case rests on FG%. He needs to get back from 41 to the 48 to 50 percent range next to Haliburton. Our data gives nothing on his threes, steals or FT%. So your threes, steals and FT% must come from players you buy earlier, not from this list. ([Aaron Nesmith](#player/412), [09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=630))

## What to check early in the season

Maluach: check that he starts over Oso Ighodaro and plays 24 or more minutes while Mark Williams is out. Experts put his ceiling at the top 75. ([Khaman Maluach](#player/344))

Nesmith: check his FG%, whether Oubre takes his starting spot, and whether Carlisle limits Haliburton's minutes. If the FG% comes back, experts say he could be a top 100 player. That is the moment to spend FAB on him. ([Aaron Nesmith](#player/412))

Eason: check Durant's minutes and any injury to Durant or Smith. At 32 minutes he would be about a top-70 player. Also note Houston's weak 10-game schedule in our playoff weeks 19 to 21, which cuts into his late value. Keep that in mind before the 2027-03-04 trade deadline. ([Tari Eason](#player/156))
